name: govern_memory
description: Composite write surface for candidate creation, review decisions, task handoffs, corrections, and supersede governance. Use action=suggest with arguments.kind=memory|rule|relation; action=decide with kind, decision=confirm|reject, and candidate_id; action=handoff; action=correct_rule; or action=supersede. This replaces the former family of low-level suggest_*/confirm_*/reject_* MCP tools.

arguments.description: Action-specific arguments; project_name is required for project writes.
